shots.cn_story: 开篇无前置。傍晚暖光中，镜头从咖啡店门口缓缓推入，穿过木质装潢的过道，最终落在靠窗角落的苏念身上。她低着头，肩头微蜷，专注地在速写本上画画，周围安静，只有笔尖摩擦纸面的细微声响。暖黄灯光从头顶打下，在她身上形成柔和的光晕。
shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in from café entrance through warm wooden interior, settling on a young woman sitting alone in a corner by the window, head bowed, drawing in a sketchbook, soft amber pendant light illuminating her, quiet peaceful atmosphere, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.audio_tags: 环境底噪, 笔尖摩擦纸面声, 远处咖啡机蒸汽声
shots.last_frame_prompt: Medium-wide shot of the young woman in cream sweater sitting alone at the corner table, head still bowed over her sketchbook, warm amber light from the pendant lamp above, window showing dusk sky behind her, same position as opening but slightly closer framing

shots.cn_story: 中景。苏晴坐在苏念对面，双手捧着咖啡杯，目光温柔而担忧地注视着苏念。她的 rust-orange 大衣搭在椅背上，贝色围巾松松围在颈间。暖光从侧面打在她的脸上，映出她微蹙的眉头。
shots.video_prompt: Medium shot of a lively young woman in a rust-orange coat and beige scarf sitting across from her quiet friend at a café table, warm side lighting, gentle concerned expression, holding a coffee cup, cozy café interior background, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.subtitle: 苏晴：你已经很久没有好好说过一句话了。
shots.audio_tags: 咖啡杯轻放桌面声, 环境底噪
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，镜头从苏念全景切至苏晴中景，两人相对而坐，光线同为暖黄侧光
shots.last_frame_prompt: Medium shot of the young woman in rust-orange coat still holding her coffee cup, her expression softening with concern, warm amber café light on her face, same position as before

shots.cn_story: 近景。苏晴微微前倾，语气更轻柔但更认真，眼神直直看着苏念，带着鼓励和心疼。她的 bob 发丝在暖光中微微发光。
shots.video_prompt: Close-up of a young East Asian woman with a black bob haircut leaning slightly forward, warm concerned eyes looking directly at someone off-camera, soft amber café lighting, emotional sincerity, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.audio_tags: 环境底噪, 轻微椅子移动声
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，镜头从苏晴中景缓慢推近至近景，光线和站位不变
shots.last_frame_prompt: Close-up of the young woman with black bob haircut, her face slightly closer to camera, eyes still warm and concerned, warm amber light catching her features, same position

shots.cn_story: 特写。苏念的手轻轻合上速写本，指尖在封面上停留片刻。镜头微微上移，露出她低垂的睫毛和安静的侧脸。她的表情没有波澜，但眼底有一丝不易察觉的波动。
shots.video_prompt: Close-up of a young woman's hands gently closing a leather sketchbook, fingers lingering on the cover, camera tilts up slightly to reveal her lowered eyelashes and quiet profile, warm soft lighting, emotional restraint, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.subtitle: 苏念（内心独白）：有些话，说出来太沉，画下来刚刚好。
shots.audio_tags: 纸张翻动声, 环境底噪
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，苏晴说完话后，镜头切至苏念的特写，她合上速写本，光线同为暖黄侧光
shots.last_frame_prompt: Close-up of the young woman's face in profile, her eyes still lowered but with a subtle shift in expression, fingers resting on the closed sketchbook, warm amber light from the side, same position

shots.cn_story: 中景。苏念站起身，双手紧紧握着速写本，深吸一口气，走向吧台。她的步伐缓慢但坚定，每一步都像是在跨越内心的障碍。暖黄灯光从头顶打下，在她身后拉出长长的影子。
shots.video_prompt: Medium shot of a young woman in a cream sweater standing up from a café table, clutching a sketchbook to her chest, taking slow determined steps toward the counter, warm overhead pendant light casting a long shadow behind her, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.audio_tags: 脚步声, 椅子拖动声, 环境底噪
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，苏念从角落起身走向吧台，手持跟拍她的背影和侧影，光线保持暖黄
shots.last_frame_prompt: Medium shot of the young woman in cream sweater arriving at the café counter, still clutching the sketchbook, her posture slightly tense but resolved, warm amber light from above, wooden counter in foreground

shots.cn_story: 近景。林夏站在吧台后，接过速写本，翻开。她的目光从一页页画着咖啡店内光影的速写上滑过，表情从平静逐渐变得柔和，最后眼眶微微泛红。她的手指轻轻抚过纸页上的铅笔线条。
shots.video_prompt: Close-up of a warm-faced café manager in a white apron receiving and opening a sketchbook, her expression shifting from calm to touched as she flips through pages of café interior drawings, eyes growing slightly red, warm amber pendant light on her face, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.audio_tags: 纸张翻动声, 环境底噪, 轻微呼吸声
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，苏念走到吧台前，镜头切至林夏近景，她接过速写本翻开，光线为吧台暖黄顶光
shots.last_frame_prompt: Close-up of the café manager's face, eyes glistening with unshed tears, lips slightly parted in a soft emotional expression, still holding the open sketchbook, warm amber light from above, same position

shots.cn_story: 近景。林夏抬起头，眼眶微红，嘴角却带着温柔的笑意。她从吧台后取出一杯拿铁，轻轻推到苏念面前。她的声音轻柔但清晰。
shots.video_prompt: Close-up of a warm café manager with glistening eyes and a gentle smile pushing a latte cup across the wooden counter toward someone off-camera, amber pendant light illuminating her face and the steaming cup, emotional and tender atmosphere, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.subtitle: 林夏：这杯叫晚安。苦后，会有回甘。
shots.audio_tags: 瓷杯轻放桌面声, 环境底噪
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，林夏从翻画本的情绪中抬起头，推过拿铁，光线和站位不变
shots.last_frame_prompt: Close-up of the café manager's face with a soft tender smile, eyes still slightly red but warm, the latte cup now resting on the counter in the foreground, warm amber light, same position

shots.cn_story: 特写。苏念站在吧台前，双手捧着那杯拿铁，热气氤氲在她脸上。她抬起头，看着林夏，嘴唇微微动了动，然后清晰地说出了那句完整的话。她的声音很轻，但每个字都很清楚。
shots.video_prompt: Close-up of a quiet young woman in a cream sweater holding a steaming latte cup, warm light from the café counter illuminating her face, she looks up and speaks for the first time with a soft but clear voice, emotional breakthrough moment, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.subtitle: 苏念：我会再来的。
shots.audio_tags: 环境底噪, 轻微呼吸声
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，林夏推过拿铁后，镜头切至苏念特写，她捧着杯子，热气升腾，光线为吧台暖光
shots.last_frame_prompt: Close-up of the young woman's face, her lips slightly parted after speaking, a faint soft smile forming, warm steam from the latte cup rising in front of her, amber counter light, same position

shots.cn_story: 全景。夜晚的街角，苏念和苏晴并肩走在人行道上，苏念回头望向咖啡店窗户里透出的暖黄灯光。林夏站在窗后，看着速写本，嘴角轻轻上扬。镜头缓缓拉远，夜色温柔，灯光温暖，画面定格在这一刻——留悬念。
shots.video_prompt: Wide night shot of a quiet urban street corner, warm golden light glowing from a café window, two figures walking away on the sidewalk, one turning back to look at the warm light, soft bokeh streetlights in the background, peaceful and hopeful atmosphere, cinematic 9:16 vertical
shots.subtitle: 林夏（内心独白）：原来有人，真的看见了。
shots.audio_tags: 夜晚环境音, 远处车流声, BGM钢琴吉他渐弱
shots.continuity_note: 承接上镜，苏念离开吧台走向门口，镜头跟随至店外，拉远展现夜色中的街角和回望的苏念
